title: IDF Strike Kills Khan Younis Criminal Police Chief Wessam Abdel-Hadi and Aide
detail: An Israeli airstrike in the Al-Amal neighborhood of Khan Younis on May 10, 2026 killed Wessam Abdel-Hadi — head of the criminal police force in Khan Younis — and his aide. Gaza's Hamas-run Interior Ministry confirmed the identities of the victims, describing the strike as 'deliberately seeking to spread chaos in Gaza and exacerbate humanitarian suffering' and as a violation of international law targeting a civil protection body. The killing is part of a sustained Israeli campaign against Hamas-run police and governance structures in Gaza during the October 2025 ceasefire period. Mourner Ali Mousa stated: 'Although the ceasefire came into effect several months ago, the occupation continues to target the police officers to cause chaos.' The strike brought the cumulative Palestinian death toll since the October 10, 2025 ceasefire to approximately 873+. The Israeli military did not immediately comment. Reuters correspondent Ramadan Abed documented the aftermath in Khan Younis, photographing the mangled wreckage of the vehicle in which Abdel-Hadi was traveling.

title: IDF Airstrike Kills Palestinian in Maghazi Refugee Camp, Central Gaza
detail: An Israeli airstrike on the Maghazi refugee camp in central Gaza on May 10, 2026 killed at least one Palestinian, according to Gaza health officials. The strike occurred alongside the Khan Younis police chief killing, bringing the total killed on May 10 to at least three. Maghazi is one of the eight refugee camps established in 1948 for Palestinians displaced in the Nakba; it has been repeatedly struck throughout the Gaza war and ceasefire period. The attack underscored the continuing fragility of the U.S.-brokered ceasefire established in October 2025, under which approximately 850–873 Palestinians have been killed as Israel conducts near-daily strikes it characterizes as targeting militants posing 'imminent threats' to its forces. The Israeli military issued no immediate comment on either strike. Both sides have continued to accuse each other of ceasefire violations.

media.caption: Israeli strikes kill three Palestinians in Gaza on May 10, 2026, testing fragile ceasefire — Khan Younis police chief and aide among dead
